03 · About
I make art for the pleasure of creating.

I’m Nicolás Insaurralde Pistilli, born in San Ignacio, Misiones, Paraguay. Painting came back into my life while living in Europe, and I’m still discovering where it can take me.

My work moves between instinct and structure, accident and intention — between chaos and form.

Nicolás · Pistillismo
